intro: Keep long descriptions compact while retaining complete text and native keyboard disclosure.
useCases: Search results, article excerpts and compact product descriptions.

faqs.question: Is an animation package required?
faqs.answer: No. These primitives use native HTML, CSS and an optional client measurement hook. They do not import Motion.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: TruncateText accepts string children and positive integer lines. ExpandableText supports controlled state, localized labels and showToggle="always" as a measurement fallback. useTextOverflow observes resize, text and font changes and can measure a collapsed text-only copy.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: The full text remains in the accessibility tree. Expansion changes visual presentation. A native button exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls; a hidden measurement copy is inaccessible and immediately removed.
